Description.SourceString:
Observation log: Dowdun Reach shows great promise, Sir*. There are innumerable places to hide. It is a messy place, half-ruined and full of dark nooks. If we were to construct an observation dome, it could hardly be better than this place.

I know you said not to use asterisks in my report, Sir, as you find them to look uncomfortably like rectums, but I was left with no choice. Dowdun Reach is in many ways an ideal place for an HQ, but in a few ways it is not ideal. Which, of course, means that 'ideal' is a poorly chosen word on my part.

I can already feel it surfacing in my reports, Sir: Dowdun Reach is making us mad. Agent Capellini's 'You have to be mad to work here' mug is looking more and more prescient by the day.

The madness has manifested in many ways. We have been seeing things. Agent Rotini came across a chicken, which he said winked at him, yet I am reasonably confident that chickens have no eyelids. We have also been bickering with each other, to the point that Agent Lasagne tried to ingest Agent Rostini whole, like a python - straight down the hatch. 

Threat assessment: Medium - we must move on, Sir. It pains me to say it, but the awesomeness of this place if undermined by its unawesomeness.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
